title: Native Sources age advances while offline
description: Run against the owned isolated stack with an existing Agent Device session selected by FARMSLOT_NATIVE_SESSION. Open Settings through its actual tab before running. Select the platform, device and Metro as in sources-live.recipe.json, and set FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1. The helper reads actual accessibility text, retains saved observation time and facts, then restores the gateway.

proofTargets.claim: The rendered stale age advances offline while saved source facts and their observation time stay unchanged and actions stay disabled.

age.intent: Read advancing native accessibility text while the owned gateway is stopped.

age-proof.intent: Require real age changes without changed data or observation time.
